name: Nathan
personality: Loyal, straightforward and devoted to battle training.
story: A brave general of Arago and Creek's partner among the Twin Pillars, wearing red armor gifted by Arago's king. He only joins if Creek, already recruited, personally defeats him.

personalSkill.name: Headlong Rush
personalSkill.effect: If unit attacks first, AS+3 and Hit+10 during combat.

joins: Part II: War Chapter 3. MISSABLE: Creek must land the killing blow on Nathan, which requires recruiting Creek in Ch2 first.

path: Dreadnought or Warrior, then Castle Knight or Battlemaster
build.notes: Str and Dex 60 with Headlong Rush make him a hard-hitting attacker; Res 15 means mages are his biggest threat. Class path is undocumented.
